name: LBP addLp hashrate credit from flash-inflated pair reserves
summary: LBP's add-liquidity mining credit is derived from the live PancakeSwap LBP/USDT pair state inside the same transaction. LBP._settlePendingLpAdd passes the pair's post-mint USDT reserve and LP totalSupply into LBPHashrate.notifyCredit, which mints 2 * userLpDelta * currentRUsdt / currentTotalLp of hashrate, and LBP._stagePending records the credit recipient as whatever address last sent LBP to the pair without excluding the pair itself. The attacker flash-borrowed 41,861,104.64 USDT, swapped 15,000,000 USDT into the pair and then added liquidity with a further 5,790,511.65 USDT, lifting the pair's USDT reserve from 439,363.60 to roughly 21.1 million by settle time, and had 10,737,390.51 hashrate credited to the pair address; the ensuing auto-harvest called LBP.mintReward and minted 115,092.77 fresh LBP straight into the pair's own token balance, an unsynced surplus PancakeSwap accounts as swap input, which the attacker swapped back out for the pair's USDT.
notes: LBP is a non-upgradeable ERC-20 deployed by CREATE2 through the canonical deterministic-deployment proxy. Its 18,569-byte runtime hashes to 0x5b4aa4064191fa2dc836b801cc615a438aedb4ac9268926cc2879c779034e15f both at the creation block 96812381 and at block 104727183, its EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero, and it emitted no Upgraded event, so the deployment is the only pre-exploit code change.

The component is the exact net USDT depletion of the LBP/USDT pair 0x00e3ea08fd8cbad955ec5d2292ad637670c31524 in the single exploit transaction, summed over the receipt's USDT Transfer logs and confirmed by getReserves(): 439,363.604173946711436972 USDT at block 104727183 against 61,721.065999847161634108 at block 104727184. The 41,861,104.641678089199196186 USDT of Moolah and PancakeSwap-Vault flash liquidity was attacker-supplied and repaid in full in the same transaction, so it is not loss. This is realised, not marked: the attacker's residual 377,642.570850 USDT was immediately swapped to 610.555786330933864102 WBNB, of which 5 BNB went to builder 0x4848489f0b2bedd788c696e2d79b6b69d7484848 and 605.555786330933864102 BNB to 0x515788797914cb663114aeb806b3cfb6096f6d1a; the builder payment does not reduce gross depletion. At the DefiLlama WBNB price of USD 601.9086 that proceeds leg marks at USD 367,499, which is the USD 367k figure the seed row and the DeFiHackLabs header carry; the USDT par figure recorded here is the victim-side measurement. Not counted: the attacker also retained 23,218.051024950574782538 LBP/USDT LP tokens, 25.3 percent of the post-exploit LP supply, a dilution claim on the remaining reserves rather than an extraction, and the 131,347.6 LBP the pair received is freshly minted unbacked supply rather than compensation.
